start.text: Fourth time. FOURTH. It takes the note, it thinks about it, it gives the note back. Same note. What is it, a bank? (The queue behind him has given up pretending to be patient.)

choices.text: Uncle, it's free today. No token needed.

free.text: Free? Nothing is free in Bengaluru, not even - (the attendant waves his whole arm) - oh. OH. Then why is the machine here? To build character?

cancel.text: Cancel. There's a cancel. Twenty years of banking and there's a - (the note slides out, flat, almost new) - see, it ironed it also.

lend.text: No, no, I'll GPay you. What's your number? (He types it into the machine's keypad. He will not GPay you.) Thank you, sir. Youngsters, I tell you - some of you are okay.

other.text: (The other queue is the same uncle, a minute from now.)

after.text: (He is explaining the cancel button to the next person in line. At length.)
